scene: The unlocked puzzle box unfolds into glowing tickets for three waiting transports.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view along the canal promenade. The grandmother in pink tracksuit and white dog stand left of centre, holding the unfolded golden box. On far left, a yellow flying scooter hovers over a pad. In centre, a double-decker hover bus idles with open doors. On far right, a streamlined hover metro pod waits at an elevated ramp.
shown: a sleek yellow flying scooter parked on a launch pad on far left
a red double-decker hover bus hovering by the kerb in centre
a sleek glass hover metro pod waiting at a raised stop on far right
